scheme_name: Grant on Passing the Written Examination of Competitive Examinations for Recruitment in Armed Forces
other_conditions: Applicant must be the child of an ex-serviceman.
Applicant must have passed the written examination of NDA, CDS, IMA, OTA, Air Force, or Naval Academy.
benefits_summary: A one‑time grant of ₹15,000 is provided to eligible children of ex‑servicemen for coaching.
